title: Data-driven accelerated multigrid method for Riesz space fractional diffusion equations
summary: The multigrid method is one of the most efficient iterative methods for solving large structured linear systems, and its efficiency stems from the complementarity between the smoother and the coarse grid correction. In this paper, we consider the block Toeplitz linear system obtained by discretizing time dependent Riesz space fractional diffusion equations, and employ the weighted Jacobi iterative method as a smoother.
